shared.layout: Unframed textbook figure; no cards, badges, shadows or decorative title. Choose aspect ratio for content, not a fixed banner.
shared.typography: Consistent labels; upright units and numerals; proper superscripts and subscripts. No decorative lettering.
shared.minimumLabelSize: At least 14 px when displayed at 360 CSS px wide. Split dense figures rather than shrinking labels.
shared.accessibility: Never encode meaning only through colour. Use labels, shapes or line patterns. No answer leakage in image or alt text.
shared.accuracy: Only facts supplied by the question. Unknown values remain unknown. The figure must not make the tested reasoning unnecessary.

mathematics.name: Precision Geometry
mathematics.typography: Neutral sans-serif labels; STIX-style mathematical expressions. Italic variables, upright numerals and units.
mathematics.conventions: Precise outlines, restrained grid, separated dimensions. Right-angle squares at the correct vertex; angle arcs only for specified angles. No inferred lengths or extra equal-side marks.
mathematics.review: Verify vertices, angle locations, dimensions, scale claims, axes, ticks and every plotted coordinate.

physics.name: Directional Mechanics
physics.typography: Inter-style technical sans-serif with tabular numerals; italic physical variables, upright SI units, consistent vector notation.
physics.conventions: Separate objects from force or velocity arrows; label arrows explicitly. Align before/after panels. Standard circuit symbols and exact connections; no substituted components.
physics.review: Verify arrow directions, reference frame, signed values, units, circuit topology and answer leakage.

chemistry.name: Molecular Structure
chemistry.typography: Noto Sans-style scientific labels; upright element symbols and formulae with true subscripts and superscript charges. Bond lines distinct from reaction arrows.
chemistry.conventions: Clean 2D structural or apparatus figures. Atom labels accompany colour when identity is given. Preserve specified counts, bonds, charges, phases and connections. No glossy decoration.
chemistry.review: Verify symbols, indices, charges, stoichiometry, bond orders, apparatus layout and safety-relevant details.

biology.name: Living Structure
biology.typography: Source Sans-style humanist labels; horizontal annotations and tidy non-crossing leader lines. Scientific names italic where appropriate.
biology.conventions: Textbook line illustrations with light flat fills. Preserve orientation; use identifiers instead of names when identification is tested. Scale bars only when supplied.
biology.review: Verify structural placement, process direction, scale claims, leader destinations and identification-task leakage.

science.name: General Science
science.typography: Neutral scientific sans-serif; upright units, clear numerals and horizontal labels.
science.conventions: Item-specific scientific figures; no generic decoration or keyword-based apparatus.
science.review: Verify objects, relationships, labels, values and answer leakage against the full question.
